name: Hayami Guren
source:
The protagonist's one year younger brother. A first year high school student. A smart guy who is also good at sports.
In the other world he is the prince of a country known for it's scholarship. He's a bit capricious, but he always sees things through to the end when he starts them. A smart guy who loves books.
